''Star Wars'' (2015) 4 establishes the [[bomb]]ing of the [[Kuat shipyards]] took place between the [[Battle of Yavin]] and its events, which corresponds to 0 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]] per ''Timelines''. |place=[[Kuat shipyards]], [[Kuat]] |result=The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[bomb]]s the [[shipyard]]s |side1=Alliance to Restore the Republic |side2=[[Galactic Empire]] |side3= |side4= |commanders1= |commanders2= |commanders3= |commanders4= |unit1= |unit2= |unit3= |unit4= |forces1= |forces2= |forces3= |forces4= |casual1= |casual2= |casual3= |casual4= |civilian= }} {{Quote|We're not doing enough.''"
"''Since the Battle of Yavin and the destruction of the Death Star, the Rebel Alliance has staged more than a dozen different attacks on almost as many worlds. We've bombed the shipyards at Kuat and the supply base on Imdaar. ''[…]'' I'm not sure what else we could possibly be doing.|Leia Organa and Gial Ackbar|}} In [[0 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Galactic Empire]], the Alliance '''bombed''' the [[Kuat shipyards|shipyards]] at the [[Core Worlds|Core]]''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' [[Planet|world]] [[Kuat]]. The [[shipyard]]'s [[bomb]]ing, which was carried out after the Rebel Alliance had [[Battle of Yavin|destroyed]] the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]], was one of over a dozen attacks undertaken to exploit a damaged Empire. The Kuat shipyards bombing was recalled by [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]] as an example of the Rebel Alliance's actions after the [[Death Star]]'s destruction during a meeting of [[Alliance High Command|Alliance leaders]] later that [[Standard year|year]] after [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] noted her belief the Rebel Alliance was not doing enough in their fight against the Empire. After his mention of the attacks, Ackbar stated he did not know what more the Alliance could be doing. ==Behind the scenes== The bombing of the Kuat shipyards was mentioned in the [[Star Wars (2015) 4|fourth issue]] of the [[2015]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series [[Star Wars (2015)|''Star Wars'']]. The issue was written by [[Jason Aaron]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[April 22]], 2015.{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/52655/star_wars_2015_4|text=Star Wars (2015) #4}} ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars (2015) 4|''Star Wars'' (2015) 4]] {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{CanonGCW}} {{Interlang |fr=Bombardement des Chantiers Spatiaux de Kuat |pl=Bombardowanie stoczni nad Kuat }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Kuat shipyards, bombing of the}} [[Category:Battles of Kuat]] [[Category:Battles of the Galactic Civil War]]
